audit_label: Position Template Audit — Round-3 Task M
post_exposure_label: produced after sc30-sc54 primary results observed

scheduling_key.construction: Mean FA_2024 over all fp nodes sharing the same pos_key. NaN filled with global mean FA_2024.

from_m4_selector_audit.note: 67 unique position-template scores for 2000 nodes. 1933 nodes share a score with >=1 other node. Max group size = 73. Tie-breaking within score groups uses hostname sort (deterministic, not thermally informed).

loo_position_score.description: Leave-one-out position score: for each node, compute pos_key group mean excluding that node

fallback_hierarchy.name: primary_LOO
fallback_hierarchy.rule: Mean FA_2024 over same pos_key, excluding the target node
fallback_hierarchy.applies_when: pos_key group has >= 2 members after excluding target

fallback_hierarchy.name: cross_chassis_slot_board_nodepos
fallback_hierarchy.rule: Mean FA_2024 over all nodes with same (slot, board, node_pos) across all chassis
fallback_hierarchy.applies_when: primary LOO not available (singleton pos_key group)

fallback_hierarchy.name: cross_chassis_slot_board
fallback_hierarchy.rule: Mean FA_2024 over all nodes with same (slot, board) across all chassis

fallback_hierarchy.name: global_mean
fallback_hierarchy.rule: Global mean FA_2024 over all fp nodes
fallback_hierarchy.applies_when: levels 1-3 not available (fallback of last resort)

loo_position_score.application_rule: Apply first level where the group has >= 2 members (after excluding target node)
loo_position_score.validation: Compute Spearman rank correlation between LOO variant scores and original LOC_FA. Report correlation between each fallback level used.
loo_position_score.status: PENDING — requires fp_node_topology.csv and FA_2024 values to compute

singleton_analysis.question: How many pos_key groups are singletons (only one node)? These nodes cannot use primary LOO and must fall back.
singleton_analysis.expected_from_selector_audit: n_duplicated_groups=57 non-singleton groups out of 67 total unique scores implies ~10 singleton groups (67 - 57 = 10 unique scores with group_size=1)

primary_challenge_result.interpretation: FP is not statistically separated from the thermally-informed structural position template at the primary choice ratio. LOO Position is a robustness check on this finding.
